spoof_2_1_1.served_time_error_note: ~1.01 ms holdover-referenced clock-solution excursion; report to ~3 sig figs (solver floor ~22 ns)

spoof_2_1_1.clock_aided_cusum_note: kref=0.5,h=5 on the clock residual vs quad holdover; alarms ~560 s after onset at ~993 us already accrued = 1x (no protection) on the slow ramp = impossibility confirmed
spoof_2_1_1.attack: common-mode time push (slow power ramp), ~1ms clock pull, position~stable

meaconing_3_1_1.attack: rebroadcast time-delay; cross-sat inconsistency, SV denial; flag stays nominal

solver.validation: per-sat clock agreement ~7-8m in clean epochs; time-offset sweep minimised residual at 0s
